question: Does GoTavern observe a config.yaml mutation made while the process is running? (pinned does NOT: startup-only)
verdict: STARTUP-ONLY (pinned parity): the mutation made while the process runs was NOT seen by the next request
notes: Same three-leg shape as the pinned probe, driven through GoTaavern's kobold generate route, which reads requestOverrides through pinnedChatConfigValue while building its provider request.
Pre-C2 expectation (the divergence): leg 2 sees "mutated", because the reader parsed config.yaml per request.
Post-C2 expectation (pinned parity): leg 2 still sees "baseline", because the parsed document is cached for the process lifetime.
Leg 3 (restart with the mutated config) must see "mutated"; it proves the key is observable through this route, so a stale leg 2 is a cache and not an unread key.
